from.place: statement, clause 'with the usual pullback restrictions': the restriction maps of $U\mapsto\Gamma(U,u^*\mathcal F)$ and the fact that they make it a presheaf (a contravariant functor on the small etale site)

title: Sections of pullbacks form a presheaf on the small etale site
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal F$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For a morphism of schemes $a:A\to B$ and a sheaf of $\mathcal O_B$-modules $\mathcal G$ let $a^*\mathcal G$ be its pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], let $\eta^a_{\mathcal G}:\mathcal G\to a_*a^*\mathcal G$ be the unit of the adjunction $a^*\dashv a_*$ [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], and for $s\in\Gamma(B,\mathcal G)$ put $a^*s=\eta^a_{\mathcal G}(s)\in\Gamma(B,a_*a^*\mathcal G)=\Gamma(A,a^*\mathcal G)$. For composable morphisms $a:A\to B$, $b:B\to C$ let $c_{a,b}:a^*b^*\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }(b\circ a)^*$ be the natural isomorphism of [lem-pc-module-pullback-identity-composition]. For objects $u:U\to X$ and $u':U'\to X$ of the small etale site $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and an $X$-morphism $g:U'\to U$ (so $u'=u\circ g$) define
$$\rho_g:\Gamma(U,u^*\mathcal F)\longrightarrow\Gamma(U',u'^*\mathcal F),\qquad \rho_g(s)=c_{g,u}\bigl(g^*s\bigr).$$
Then:
1. $\rho_g$ is a homomorphism of abelian groups, and $\rho_g(as)=g^\sharp(a)\,\rho_g(s)$ for $a\in\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$, $s\in\Gamma(U,u^*\mathcal F)$;
2. $\rho_{\mathrm{id}_U}=\mathrm{id}$;
3. for $X$-morphisms $h:U''\to U'$ and $g:U'\to U$ of $X_{\Et}$, $\rho_{g\circ h}=\rho_h\circ\rho_g$.

Hence $u\mapsto\Gamma(U,u^*\mathcal F)$, $g\mapsto\rho_g$, is a presheaf of abelian groups (a contravariant functor from $X_{\Et}$ to abelian groups).
